finalText: Repeats of the same key within 5 minutes now drop, tracked per-key in `state`. Verified with `simulate.js` (e.g. two `quota-warning` flaps 2 minutes apart at :01/:03 — first queues, second drops) and a full run shows 99 total drops from this rule. As a bonus, this now also happens to match everything in the repo's `verify.js` test file, which converged to the same spec as your string of change requests.
